title: ClassroomInsight Contract Schema
description: Frozen shared contract for the ClassroomInsight multi-agent system. Defines the shared student-state object and the output contracts for Person C agents.

ApproachUsed.title: ApproachUsed
ApproachUsed.description: The intervention approach delivered to a student. Use underscores exactly as shown.

StatusValue.title: StatusValue
StatusValue.description: Lifecycle status of a student in the intervention/verification loop.

VerificationResult.title: VerificationResult
VerificationResult.description: Outcome of the verification probe. Must be a flat enum string — never an object.

StudentState.title: StudentState
StudentState.description: Shared student-state object. Written exclusively by Person B (loop_controller.py) into shared/live_state.json. Read by Person C. Must contain exactly these 10 fields.

topic.description: Current learning topic where the misconception was observed.

status.description: Current state in the intervention/verification lifecycle. Must be one of the allowed enum values. 'verifying' is a distinct intermediate state between 'intervened' and a verification result. 'escalated' is set when verification_result is 'unresolved'. False mastery uses status='verified' combined with flagged_false_mastery=true.

attempts.description: Number of intervention attempts. Incremented each time a new intervention begins.

resource_given.description: A flat string describing the resource or intervention delivered to the student. MUST NOT be a nested object.

approach_used.description: The most recently used intervention approach. Top-level field using underscore naming.

previous_approaches.description: Persistent list of all intervention approaches already used for the current misconception loop. Allows the recommender to avoid repeating an approach. The most recent approach also appears in approach_used.

verification_result.description: Outcome of the most recent verification probe. Must be a flat enum string — never an object. Set to 'pending' until verification completes.

flagged_false_mastery.description: Set to true when verification_result is 'surface_mastery'. Persistent — remains true even after status transitions to 'verified'. Allows teachers to identify students who demonstrated surface mastery.

LiveState.title: LiveState
LiveState.description: Contents of shared/live_state.json. A JSON array of StudentState objects. Written exclusively by Person B's loop_controller.py after every successful advance().

ClassroomInsightOutput.title: ClassroomInsightOutput
ClassroomInsightOutput.description: Output contract for person-c-classroom/classroom_insight_agent.py. A ranked list of classroom-level misconceptions, sorted by student_count descending.

student_count.description: Number of students sharing this misconception on this topic.

topic.description: The topic where this misconception was observed.

RootCauseOutput.title: RootCauseOutput
RootCauseOutput.description: Output contract for person-c-classroom/root_cause_agent.py. Identifies downstream topics affected by a misconception via reverse traversal of shared/prereq_graph.json.

downstream_topics.description: Alphabetically sorted list of topics that directly or indirectly depend on the affected topic. Does not include the original topic itself. Empty if no downstream topics exist.

urgency.description: High if len(downstream_topics) >= URGENCY_HIGH_THRESHOLD (2), low otherwise.

teacher_explanation.description: Deterministic, template-based explanation grounded only in the actual downstream_topics list. Must not introduce topics absent from downstream_topics.

AssessmentQualityOutput.title: AssessmentQualityOutput
AssessmentQualityOutput.description: Output contract for person-c-classroom/assessment_quality_agent.py. Analyzes one question's answer distribution for potential ambiguity. Constants: SAME_WRONG_ANSWER_THRESHOLD=0.60, MIN_STUDENTS_FOR_FLAG=3.

question_id.description: Identifier for the question being analyzed.

flagged.description: True when the most-selected answer option accounts for >= SAME_WRONG_ANSWER_THRESHOLD of all responses AND total responses >= MIN_STUDENTS_FOR_FLAG.

possibly_ambiguous_question.description: True only when flagged is true. Must be false whenever flagged is false.

reasoning.description: Concise explanation of the flagging decision grounded in the actual answer distribution.

description: Top-level schema document. Use $defs to reference individual contracts.
